name: Plate VIII: The Pentalpha
description: The pentagram of the Pythagoreans, sign of Hygieia, whose heart holds a smaller star, and that one another, without end. Struck in Citrinitas: the yellowing, the dawn of the solar light within the work. “QVOD EST SVPERIVS EST SICVT QVOD INFERIVS”: That which is above is as that which is below.
